content.text: {"decision":"explain","likely_cause":"Likely cause: on the item:list screen, users repeatedly reverse direction in the Scroll container (scroll_y goes 3600 then 2950, 5150 then 4250, 6850 then 6050) while the pointer rests on the Item 190 row without any click or typing in between, which suggests the target row is not reliably in view and users keep scrolling back and forth to find it.","fix":"Fix: On the item:list screen, add a search or filter input above the Scroll container that narrows the item rows by name, so users can bring the target row into view without repeated scrolling in the Scroll container.","cited_event_ids":["99","101","103","105","107","108","110","100:101","104:105","109:110","111:113","73","75"],"confidence":"med","unsupported":["Whether Item 190 was the row the users were looking for; the events do not show intent","Why each direction reversal happened; the events do not show what was rendered in the Scroll container","Whether a search or filter would reduce the 8.6 s median time lost; the effect of the fix is not verified","Pointer samples are rounded and sampled at about 2 Hz, so they show approximate resting position, not confirmed hover"]}
